summary: The note defines oblasts of the Soviet Union as second-level administrative entities within the Soviet Union and first-level entities within its constituent republics. It is a very short stub giving only this basic definition.
one_line: Defines the oblasts of the Soviet Union as second-level administrative divisions of the USSR and first-level divisions of its republics.
key_facts: The oblasts of the Soviet Union were second-level entities of the Soviet Union.
The oblasts of the Soviet Union were first-level entities of the republics of the Soviet Union.

entities.name: Soviet Union
entities.role: state whose second-level entities were the oblasts
